discovery_result.query: What are the latest developments in AI agents (last 6 months)

item.title: Introducing GPT‑5.5
item.snippet: OpenAI announces GPT‑5.5 (and GPT‑5.5 Pro): a step-change model focused on agentic capabilities (longer persistence, improved tool use, coding and computer-use skills). Includes evaluation results across multiple agent benchmarks (Terminal‑Bench, OSWorld, SWE‑Bench variants), rollout/availability notes, and updated system card / safeguards.
item.discovery_query: OpenAI agents GPT-5.5 release April 2026 "introducing gpt-5.5"

items.reason: Primary product release and primary evidence of recent model capability and benchmark claims (agentic capabilities + safety notes).

item.title: The next evolution of the Agents SDK
item.snippet: OpenAI describes updates to its Agents SDK: a model-native harness for the agent loop, native sandbox execution, separation of harness from compute, security-focused sandboxing, Python first with TypeScript planned — important implementation and developer-facing changes for building and deploying agents.
item.discovery_query: The next evolution of the Agents SDK OpenAI April 2026 "Agents SDK"

items.reason: Primary SDK changelog / product documentation describing agent harness, sandboxing, and developer features (matches evidence requirements for release notes and SDK docs).

item.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Version 1.0
item.snippet: Microsoft announces Microsoft Agent Framework v1.0 (GA) — unifying Semantic Kernel and AutoGen into a single open-source SDK (Python/.NET), multi-provider model support, A2A and MCP interoperability, migration guidance and code samples for building production multi-agent systems.

items.reason: Primary developer-facing announcement from Microsoft that signals important ecosystem consolidation (open-source framework, migration path, multi-provider support).

item.title: A3: An Automated Alignment Agent for Safety Finetuning
item.source_type: official company/lab research blog / open-source release
item.snippet: Anthropic presents A3, an agentic automated-alignment pipeline that generates targeted adversarial examples, splits training/OOD data, and iteratively finetunes models (LoRA, adaptive weighting) to reduce safety-failure rates. The post includes experimental results and links to an open-source code release.
item.discovery_query: Anthropic Automated Alignment Agent A3 March 2026 'A3' 'automated alignment agent'

items.reason: Primary research/safety output with code release that directly addresses safety methods for agentic systems (meets safety organisation / independent-analysis requirements).

item.title: Benchmark Test‑Time Scaling of General LLM Agents (arXiv)
item.snippet: ArXiv preprint introducing General AgentBench and studying test-time scaling behaviors for general LLM agents across search, coding, reasoning and tool-use domains. Reports that agents' performance degrades when evaluated in unified general-agent settings and provides code and dataset links — relevant benchmark/evaluation evidence.
item.discovery_query: Benchmark Test-Time Scaling of General LLM Agents arXiv Feb 2026 'General AgentBench'

items.reason: Recent academic benchmark paper providing concrete evaluation methodology, results, and public code — important to assess claimed agent progress and limitations.
